paragraphs.text: “What are you?” you demand. “Tell me your nature!”

The thing that was Charlie rasps, “You cannot compel me to 
speak!” Her voice sounds like a sledge dragged over stones.

To force her to speak, attempt a POW roll with a penalty die: if you 
succeed, go to 447; if you fail, go to 446.
